{{Quote|My blurrg may be ill-tempered but she's much faster than your riding machine.|[[Tae Boon/Legends|Tae Boon]] to [[Stak/Legends|Stak]]|translated=1|audio=BlurrgIllTempered-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>}}
The '''blurrgs''' were a two-legged reptilian [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived on the plains of the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], as well as the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. 

They were used by the [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] Marauders living on that moon to do their heavy labor. The Sanyassans originally used them as attack creatures, but they were too calm and slow while carrying cargo, so they used them as beasts of burden instead. They controlled them with spiked chain [[bridle]]s, riding on their backs with stiff [[Saddle/Legends|saddles]].<ref name="EBFE">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|What is a blurrg?''"<br />"''Big lizard. Walks on its hind legs. Three-Toe, the children call it. We tame it as a mount. It is strong, though stupid. But when driven to fury, it is dangerous.|A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and [[Jorak]]|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
[[File:Blurrg2-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|270x270px|A blurrg, with young, next to an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] for size comparison]]
The blurrg's huge mouth could chew through almost anything edible, which made it perfect for clearing savanna grass, weeds, and saplings.<ref name=":0" /> They used their long tails for defense.<ref name="SWTCWCE" /> Blurrgs were rather unintelligent, so much so that they walked right into small trees, knocking them down. Their brain was the size of a [[jubba nut]].<ref name=":0" /> 

Blurrgs from Ryloth were known for their speed and ferocity. While Blurrgs hailing from Endor, were slow and placid.<ref name="SWTCWCE" />

The egg-laying creatures usually produced five or six babies at a time. In their early years, babies stayed very close to their mothers for protection from [[Boar-wolf/Legends|Boar-wolves]]. Blurrgs communicated through a series of low roars.<ref name=":0">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> They were vicious when driven to a fury and reputedly noisy when agitated.

==History==
[[File:Blurrg.jpg|thumb|270x270px|Blurrgs on Endor]]
During the time of the [[Third Galactic War]], small blurrgs were frequently kept as pets, and were sold across the galaxy, with a variety of different breeds being available to buy.<ref name="Bundle">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=item|Mossrankle Blurrg|Cartel Market}}</ref>

A millenia later, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Blurrg trooper|clone troopers mounted on blurrgs]] were used as heavy cavalry on various worlds. [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] somehow acquired dozens of blurrgs, and used them as beasts of burden and as riding mounts against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

There was also a location on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] named [[Blurrg's Isle]], which seemed to be the home of a significant population of blurrgs.

During the time of the [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|Mission to Zygerria]], some blurrgs were sold in the markets of [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]].<ref name="Slaves">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>

[[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] sold blurrgs as mounts to Imperial forces. They cost 12000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for six or 20000 credits for a herd of 12.<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
